description: This file is a shell script for managing iptables firewall rules, including saving, restoring, and conditional modification of rules for network traffic handling, specifically for gateway restoration and backup tasks.
calls: iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -i brlan0 -p udp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to 10.0.0.1
iptables -t nat -D PREROUTING -i brlan0 -p tcp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to 10.0.0.1
iptables -D FORWARD -i eth0 -o brlan0 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -t nat -D prerouting_mgmt_override -p tcp -m multiport --dports ${TRPORT},22 -j ACCEPT
dmcli simu getv Device.ManagementServer.X_CISCO_COM_ConnectionRequestURLPort | grep value | cut -f3 -d : | cut -f2 -d" "
dmcli simu getv Device.DeviceInfo.X_COMCAST_COM_xfinitywifiEnable | grep value | cut -f3 -d : | cut -f2 -d " "
